report:
The supplied updated set supports completed Experiment acquisition in three focal accounts: A04, A05 and A11, totaling six distinct account–product acquisition categories. It does not establish six purchase events. The apparent initial subset is A01/A02/A04/A05/A12 and the additions are A11/A14/A15/A16; no separate initial-stage manifest was supplied, so the stage comparison uses that grouping.

Initial stage: A04 narrates buying Super Saturated, Buffer Jelly, face wash (apparently Plasma Wash) and mesh moisturizer (apparently Molecular Mesh). Sister-led discovery and positive Super Saturated experience precede expansion; greater nighttime hydration/repair is an explicit reason for Buffer Jelly. Subsequent praise includes cleansing, makeup removal, hydration and packaging colors, but not every attribute is explicitly a purchase cause. A05 narrates immediate Avant Guard checkout following TikTok discovery in the context of wanting a sustainable alternative to disposable sheet masks. These are two credited retailer origins reporting acquisition, with different product-specific reasons. A01 reports comment-induced Softwear cart readdition only. A02's skipped product and favored baste balm concern Dr. Idriss in context. A12's cream 2.0 and cleanser acquisitions concern Regimen Lab, not Experiment.

Updated stage: A11 adds explicit Softwear stock-up during months of loving it, followed by reported dermatitis, prescribed steroid cream, a worse flare within 24 hours of retrying, and three unopened tubes described as a $70 CAD loss. This is adverse experience alongside enduring affection and qualified recommendation. A14 adds gifted Buffer Jelly receipt and favorable experience after two uses mixed into moisturizer, not purchase. A15 adds contemplated Plasma Wash return after poor cleansing, dryness and severe eye burning, without a completed return. A16 adds intended Continuum substitution for existing azelaic- and salicylic-acid products, without completed substitution or narrated acquisition. A04 reports no further makeup-remover need; that does not explicitly establish actually discontinuing a separate routine product.

Corroboration is proposition-specific. Completed acquisition repeats across three credited retailer accounts; specific motivations mostly remain individual self-attributions. A04 and A11 both link further acquisition to prior product satisfaction, but across different products. Context-only cowrunamuck independently reports Softwear backups because of love and former shipping inconvenience, qualitatively repeating A11's satisfaction-linked stock-up reason in another customer venue. It adds no focal count and does not establish a distinct source-role route to cross-venue corroboration. Its detailed recommendation explains A01's cart reference without donating product experience or checkout to A01. No bare agreeing reply here establishes additional Experiment buying.

Performance evidence is mixed: A04's favorable face-wash account opposes A15's Plasma Wash experience, subject to the inferred face-wash identification. Softwear praise coexists with A11's serious adverse report; context-only sensitive-skin tolerance does not invalidate it. Buffer Jelly praise repeats in A04 and gifted A14, but A14's two-use, moisturizer-mixed experience cannot isolate its effect. Formulas/versions and most purchased variants remain unknown. These selected self-reports establish neither market prevalence nor general causal buying effects; A11's causation claim remains the reviewer's attribution.

Engagement: A01/A02/A12 have native Reddit scores 13/4/12, with observation times unavailable and supplied engagement explicitly uninterpreted. Every focal Junip review has 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes at its supplied observation timestamp. Context-only cowrunamuck and RowanVC have scores 21 and 42 respectively, with observation times unavailable. These are raw audience signals, not verified experiences, independent buyers or buying consequences; material resonance is not established. A01, A02 and both contextual commenters share one thread but have different visible handles; Reddit independence remains unverified. No supplied context duplicates a focal actor.

source_index.findings: boxybrown84, Reddit, 2025-09-05; score 13, observation time unavailable. Explicitly removed then readded Experiment balm to FF cart because of a comment; parent identifies Softwear. No checkout, acquisition or use established; variant/version unknown. Parent cowrunamuck (same thread, distinct handle; score 21) separately praises smoothness, moisture, scent-free character and superiority to Eadem, reports sensitive-skin tolerance and two backups motivated by love plus earlier website-shipping inconvenience, and welcomes Sephora availability. This context is detailed testimony from its own actor, outside focal counts.

PamelaDamnela, Reddit, 2025-09-05; score 4, observation time unavailable. Owns but skips 'that one' because of its feel; loves baste balm. Parent resolves these to Dr. Idriss exfoliator and Barrier Baste, not Experiment buying. Context-only RowanVC (score 42, same thread, distinct handle) praises Experiment Softwear and the brand, separately describes sticky Dr. Idriss exfoliator layered with lanolin/other balm and soft lips afterward. Their general balm stash is not an explicit Experiment stock-up.

Junip customer 202931541, 2025-03-22; 0 up/0 down observed 2025-03-23. Four narrated Experiment acquisition categories: Super Saturated after sister introduction and liking it; Buffer Jelly for additional nighttime hydration/repair; face wash, apparently Plasma Wash; mesh moisturizer, apparently Molecular Mesh, immediately at launch. Reports lightweight, fast-drying hydration before makeup, glowy clean skin after Buffer Jelly, makeup removal/no breakouts and hydrated skin with wash; loves colorful packaging. Individual reported outcomes, not isolated causal tests. 'No more makeup remover needed' is not explicit completed routine discontinuation. Metadata targets Super Saturated Refill and verified buyer; it adds no separately narrated refill purchase. Purchased variants/formula versions unknown.

Junip customer 44968672, 2022-11-03; 0 up/0 down observed that date. Explicit immediate checkout of reusable Avant Guard following TikTok creator discovery, against a stated sustainability goal and discontinued frequent disposable masking. Reports almost-perfect fit except cheek sides/nose, easy cleaning, and motivation to use other hydrating/moisturizing products credited with barrier improvement; mask-alone benefit unproven. Metadata identifies Acid Lime/SMALL, verified buyer. One acquisition category; no explicit repurchase.

eratch, Reddit, 2025-01-16; score 12, observation time unavailable. Context identifies Regimen Lab: acquired cream 2.0 seeking healing moisturizer after overusing tret and also acquired cleanser. Impressed with formulations, calls cleanser nice but small, intends further line exploration, especially serums/moisturizer. These are other-brand acquisitions and intentions, with no Experiment acquisition.

Junip customer 178058824, 2024-11-25; 0 up/0 down observed that date. Explicit Softwear stock-up during months of loving it: one acquisition category, not three events from three unopened tubes. Influencer recommended it; initial praise includes thick texture and sheen despite resistance and daily dead-skin removal. Reports later perioral dermatitis, prescribed steroid cream, recovery and worse flare within 24 hours of retry; attributes cause to Softwear, without independent medical confirmation. Describes $70 CAD stranded stock, devastation, continuing affection and qualified recommendation. No completed return/refund narrated; formula unknown.

Junip customer 344086099, 2025-08-05; 0 up/0 down observed 2025-08-20. Explicit free Buffer Jelly receipt for an honest review, not paid acquisition. After two uses adding a drop to nighttime moisturizer with rosacea, reports soft skin without redness, irritation or clogged pores and silky jelly-to-oil texture. Declares conversion; dermaplaning suitability and long bottle life are expectations. Initially surprised by small bottle, explains it as reduced packaging/full 1 oz. Formula unknown. Metadata says rewarded=false and verified_buyer=false; rewarded flag does not erase disclosed gifting.

Junip customer 210150638, 2024-11-04; 0 up/0 down observed that date. Plasma Wash use across amounts, wet/dry skin and lathering methods reportedly yielded poor cleansing, little/no foam, severe eye burning and more dryness with repeat cleansing, despite beautiful silky texture. Considered returning; no completed return or explicitly narrated purchase. Prefers unnamed existing glycerin cleanser and questions defective unit or technique against social-media praise. Verified-buyer metadata alone excluded from acquisition count; version unknown.

Junip customer 529373073, 2026-05-29; 0 up/0 down observed 2026-06-11. Continuum use with light gel-serum texture, mild chemical smell, no sensitivity and reportedly less-red active acne next morning. Praises easy packaging and parabens as science-first formulation. Intends to replace existing azelaic- and salicylic-acid products for simplicity and make it a staple; neither completed substitution nor acquisition narrated. Explicitly cannot assess acne/pigmentation efficacy objectively. Verified-buyer/First Time metadata adds no acquisition assertion; formula version unknown.
